notes: Second pass (2026-10-26): no web hit ties 9422404 to a size. Tried bare number, GM/Corvette/console context, AMK catalog, GMPartsWiki snippets. A classicoldsmobile.com thread lists '9422404 firewall regulator' and seems to match it to AMK B-11069, but AMK lists B-11069 under OEM 9423354 (#6 hex washer), so it is not used. Thread page 403. Pass 4: 1972 Oldsmobile Parts & Accessories Catalog (GMPartsWiki OCR) lists '9422404 ... SCREW reg to body W 14 x Vi' (69-71 regulator). OCR is garbled (possibly #14 x 1/2) so no size recorded; a clean scan of that page would settle it.
